text:
Type: cross-back wooden dining chair
Use: dining, sitting at a table; dining room, kitchen
Style: farmhouse, Scandinavian, traditional
Materials: solid wood with a white painted finish
Colors: white, warm off-white
Shape: curved top rail over an X-shaped cross back, flat solid seat with a straight apron, square tapered legs, upright frame, medium visual weight
Feel: bright, fresh, homely, classic
Goes with: white or light wood tables, pale walls, linen textiles; farmhouse kitchens, Scandinavian or cottage dining rooms

product.name: INGOLF
product.description: Solid wood is a hardwearing natural material.
